Hi, Liam! Thanks for the call. I have some questions about the team day in March.
Sure, Andrea! I love talking about our team. What do you want to know?
First, what do people in Sydney enjoy doing together?
They enjoy cooking together, and they love being outside. But they can’t stand long meetings!
Like my team in Brazil. And at work, what do they avoid doing?
Paperwork! Everybody avoids doing it. And my pet peeve is people working overtime every day.
I agree. I don’t mind working late sometimes, but on my day off I want to unwind.
Good idea. So how do you unwind?
I enjoy reading physical books, and I love listening to U2 in the car. And you?
I’m a people person, so I enjoy meeting friends at the beach. I’ll send you the team list today.

Hi, I'm Emma, and I'm an HR manager in Edinburgh. Every year we ask our people three questions. What do you enjoy doing at work? What do you hate doing? And what don't you mind doing? This year, two hundred people answered. The number one answer for enjoy was working with the team. The number one answer for hate was paperwork: nobody likes filling in forms. And the surprise? A lot of people don't mind working overtime, but only one or two days a month. So next year we are going to change the forms and make them shorter. Small changes, happy people.

Hello, I'm Oliver, and I'm a recruiter in London. I'm a people person, so I love meeting candidates and talking to people all day. I don't mind small talk, and I don't mind dealing with difficult questions. But I hate doing paperwork, and my pet peeve is candidates who arrive late without a message. On my day off, I avoid checking my emails. I enjoy cooking for my family, and I love walking in the countryside. That's how I unwind. On Monday, I'm ready again.
